Nushell does not have `eval`, so past instructions lead to a first nu init-file (env.nu?) creating a `starship.nu` in the cache directory that was sourced in the second init-file (init.nu?). Sourcing and creating the same file isn't possible with nushell in the same invocation.

The old and new log dir is the same on Linux (if `XDG_CACHE_HOME` is not set to a different location) and since we rely on `new_log_dir/.migrated`, we can't unconditionally remove the old log dir.

- IIRC [some] nushell users may have non-log files?
